items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Everybody has their stamp of what — like Sweets you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Once you hear it, oh, that’s Ricky.

That’s their schtick. Everybody has their stamp of what — like Sweets you know. [scats] And Curtis always did that. [scats] And so on the last record, “The Good News Blues,” we did Mr. CP and we dedicated it to him. So we took all of his pet phrases and put it together on that song. It’s on the record we gave you.
